purpose: Phase 4: the phase-1 H~ (QTIP_G_W2, closed loop 208) plus a zero-bit output-row scale from the same probes, one arm on QTIP W2, one g1 GPU. Separate from host.json so the phase-3 job's sources stay unchanged.
row_weight: results/hessians/<i>.pt 'row_weight': d_c = sum over the 80 C80 contexts and all calls of sum_t g_tc^2 |x_t|^2 of the A + lambda Z + beta K probe cotangents (phase-1 per-token definition); rowcheck 26046194: split-half predicted guided-loss ratio 0.845 (in sample 0.817), half correlation 0.86
row_scale_rule: s_c^2 = sqrt(d_c)/|W_c| (minimizes (sum d_c/s_c^2)(sum s_c^2 |W_c|^2)), geometric mean 1, clipped to [1/limit, limit]; QTIP quantizes diag(s) W on H~ with the baseline seed and the dequantized rows are divided by s, i.e. s folds into QTIP's fp32 SV: 0 extra bits, no gradient updates. A layer without probe signal keeps s = 1

allocation.ncpus_basis: QTIP ~1-2 cores, 2 loop workers ~4 cores (26043905 / 26046240 CPU_SAMPLE); PBS sets 16 per GPU on the GPU queues regardless
allocation.memory_basis: 26043905 used 56 GB with 4 loop workers on 2 GPUs; here 2 workers

steps: quant: QTIP W2 on H~ with the row scale, 614 layers; proxies of the three QTIP W2 weights (baseline, phase 1, this arm) under H_U, H~ and H~ with the row weights
eval: held-out 40x2 with the C1 swap
loop: LIBERO-Plus 280, 2 workers on the GPU
final: results/rows/RESULTS.zh.md, three QTIP W2 arms, paired counts with McNemar p
